identity.name: Politico
identity.description: An American political and policy news organisation covering Congress, the White House, lobbying, elections and European politics.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Acquired by Axel Springer in 2021. Politico operates as a commercial subscription and advertising business with a strong insider-politics focus.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Insider political reporting with bylined sourcing; no evidence of a single-party editorial line, though access journalism shapes framing.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center and High factual reporting; coverage is process-focused and broadly centrist with a Washington-insider lens.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business and lobbying coverage is descriptive and interest-group aware rather than ideologically pro-market.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames politics through US and EU governing institutions and elite policy networks.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; strong sourcing within political institutions.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Washington and Brussels insider voice. Explains politics through legislative process, campaigns, lobbying and institutional power rather than ideology or street-level impact.

selectionRationale: Provides granular US and EU political-process coverage that general international feeds miss.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Politico's own company page returned 403; ownership verified through Axel Springer. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
